children: Much of the market is down today, but not all.
The S&P 500 index's consumer staples sector gained 1% Friday midafternoon, outperforming the benchmark index's 3.2% slide. Energy and health care both rose slightly.

Overall, about one-third of S&P 500 stocks are actually up today, way more than yesterday, when fewer than 10% of the stocks rose but the index held up better due to the largest stocks declining less.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
